claims.text: On the October 23, 2026 marks, the paper vol book sizes off the worst loss on its shock grid, not the normal-day yardstick. Both numbers print on the page.

Bogey bridge at the 2026-10-23 marks: the grinder rows (S3 fade, S5 overwrite, S6 condor candidate, S8 capped straddle candidate), each sized to a 0.5R shock budget inside a 1R worst-case cap, carry about $581,920 a month of GROSS rent against the $500,000 bogey. Gross means cycles complete; no expected-rent figure is claimed, because the record is 1 marked day(s) long and the stay-inside share is unmeasured.
